In the long jump our man, Clemens (who also won the Club handicap) jumped 21 ft. 3 ins., but was beaten by an inch by J. Simpson, the Manchester University and L.A.C. athlete.
Five points each was the outcome of 440 yards, Tosh and Michael running well behind a much fitter man in J. Simpson, also a Metropolitan Police runner.
